title: soccer tool result
description: Each run executes exactly one soccer-mcp tool call and stores: the tool result as a dataset item, plus run metadata in the key-value store.

result.title: Tool result (dataset item)
result.description: One dataset item: {tool, arguments, ok, data, duration_ms, generated_at}. data holds the tool's JSON result (fixtures, settlement, fair odds, Kelly sizing etc.).

runInfo.title: Run info (OUTPUT key)
runInfo.description: JSON object with run metadata: tool, ok, duration, generated_at.
